questions.cardText:
[Mathematics] Whose theorem states that every non-negative integer can be expressed as a sum of four integer squares?
A. Pierre de Fermat
B. Joseph-Louis Lagrange
C. Leonhard Euler
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wessen Satz besagt, dass sich jede nichtnegative ganze Zahl als Summe von vier Quadratzahlen darstellen lässt?
questions.en: Whose theorem states that every non-negative integer can be expressed as a sum of four integer squares?

timeline.labelEn: Joseph-Louis Lagrange proves the four-square theorem

questions.notes: Also known as Bachet's conjecture; Lagrange proved it in 1770 (Wikipedia).

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Where do pearlfish typically live?
A. Attached to a larger fish
B. On land
C. Inside another animal
Answer: C. Pearlfish often live inside the body cavities of sea cucumbers, entering through the sea cucumber’s anus while a sea cucumber breathes by taking in water through its anus. While inside, pearlfish can sometimes consume the sea cucumber’s organs.
questions.de: In welchem Meerestier leben Perlfische oft, in das sie durch dessen After eindringen, während es atmet?
questions.en: Pearlfish often live inside which marine animal, entering it through its anus while it breathes?

timeline.labelEn: Felipe Poey names the pearlfish family Carapidae
timeline.labelDe: Felipe Poey benennt die Familie der Perlfische (Carapidae)

questions.notes: Wikipedia: adults of most species live inside invertebrates — clams, sea cucumbers, starfish or sea squirts; some species parasitise sea cucumbers, eating their gonads. Sea cucumber is the classic host the card's explanation names.
